transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just... I'm hearing things. Voices, mostly. They sound like they're right there in my studio with me. Just... calling my name, telling me my work is being judged. Even when it's completely quiet and I know I'm alone.
What kind of things are the voices saying about your work?

Just... I don't know. They just keep saying my name... and telling me it's being judged. Like people are watching it. It's just... it sounds exactly like somebody is standing right there next to me, saying it out loud. Even when the whole house is completely quiet and I know nobody else is there. I don't really like talking about what they say.
Are the voices ever telling you to do something or are they just commenting on your work?

They... they mostly just comment. Like I said, they just say my name. Tell me people are looking at my things, judging it. It's just... it's just really clear, like someone is standing right there in the room. I don't really want to get into the rest of it.
Do the voices ever tell you to do something specific?
No. I... I already said. They don't tell me to do things. They just... they just talk. That's all.
Do you ever find it hard to express your thoughts or feel like your thoughts are disjointed?
I don't... no, I don't think so. I don't really know what you mean by disjointed. My thoughts are just normal. I can talk fine.
Have you noticed any changes in your behavior or daily activities since the voices started?

I... I don't know. I guess I do some things differently sometimes. Like at work, when I'm visiting a client. Sometimes I just... stop. I don't finish what I was doing. I might just start lining things up instead. Like the rubber gloves, or those little plastic pill cups... maybe some of my crochet scraps. Just putting them in patterns. Or... or I'll just stand out in the hallway. Just staring. Like I'm waiting for a signal or something. I don't know why.
Can you tell me more about what you mean by lining things up in patterns?

I just... I just put them in a row. It's not a big deal. Like I said, I'll be at a client's house and I just... I stop doing what I'm supposed to do. I take the gloves, or the little cups, or pieces of yarn from my crocheting... and I just put them in a line. Or a circle. And sometimes I don't do that, sometimes I just... go stand in the hall. And I stare. Just... waiting. Like a signal is coming. That's all it is.
Do you feel like your thoughts are connected and make sense when you're not hearing the voices?

I... I don't know if they make sense. Sometimes they just... they go too fast. Even without the voices. It's like... I'll be thinking about a client's medicine, and then suddenly I'm worrying about my rent, and then... then I'm thinking about the title of a painting, or... or a message in a song on the radio. It all just runs together so fast. I can't... I can't slow it down to figure it out.
Do you feel like you can control what you're thinking about when the voices aren't there?

Not really. It's... hard to hold onto things. I'll try to finish a care note, or just... a row of my crocheting. But then... I don't know, a car door shuts outside. Or maybe there's a bird at the window, or... just a color on the table. It just pulls me away. I'm off doing something else before I even know it. So... no.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are not making sense to you or are hard to follow?
I... I don't really know. They're just my thoughts. I guess they make sense to me, even if there's a lot of them. I haven't really... thought about it like that.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are being controlled by something or someone outside of yourself?
No... I don't think so. They're just mine. Nobody is... making me think them. They just happen.
Do you often find it hard to stay on one topic when you're talking or thinking about something?

I guess so. Sometimes they just... go too fast. Like, I'll be thinking about a client's medicine, and then... suddenly it's about my rent, or... a title of a painting, or... a message in a song I heard. It's just a lot all at once. I can't really slow it down.
Do you find it hard to keep your thoughts in order when you're talking to someone?
I don't think so. I just... say what I need to. People seem to understand me fine. I don't really... talk that much anyway.
Have you had difficulty interacting with others or performing your job because of the voices or your thoughts?

Yeah... I suppose so. My job was... in danger, I guess. I missed some shifts. Kept mixing up the care notes... I just couldn't keep the visits organized the way I used to. And... I don't really see people right now. I stopped going to my walking club... and the art talks at the library. So... I'm mostly just at home. Alone.
Do you often have trouble understanding what you're trying to say when you're talking to someone?
No... I don't think so. I know what I mean when I talk. I just... don't have much to say to anyone.
Do you often find yourself jumping from one idea to another without finishing the first one when you're talking or thinking?

I guess... sometimes. My mind just goes. It runs so fast. I'll be thinking about... a client's medicine, and then suddenly I'm worrying about rent... and then it's a title of a painting... or something I heard in a song. It just keeps going... and I can't slow it down enough to... make sense of it.
Do you often find it hard to express your thoughts in a way that makes sense to others?
I don't know... I haven't really noticed that. Like I said, I just... don't talk to many people right now.
Do you often find yourself saying things that don't make sense to others when you're talking?
No... I don't think so. Nobody has ever told me that. I mostly just keep to myself anyway.
Do you think others have difficulty understanding what you're trying to communicate when you talk to them?
I... it's just like I said before. I don't really talk to anyone right now. So... I wouldn't really know if they understand me or not. They haven't said.
Do you often find yourself saying things that seem out of place or unrelated when you're talking to someone?
No... not really. I just... I say what I need to, if I have to talk. But mostly I'm just quiet.
